programme.title: La fièvre
programme.desc: Maroc, une nuit de fièvre, une enfant perçoit la présence d'un fantôme. C'est une exilée politique, de retour dans son pays natal après une longue absence. Dans le noir et les délires de la fièvre, récit muet, voix sans corps et visions s'entremêlent. L'enfant d'aujourd'hui et le fantôme de la femme se confondent, en un voyage dans l'espace et le temps qui va mener l'exilée politique à une étrange bâtisse, à sa mémoire perdue. Le récit de la décolonisation et de luttes oubliées ressurgissent, avant que de nouvelles luttes, celles du «printemps arabe» au Maroc, submergent le passé.

programme.title: Battlefield Earth
programme.desc: Nous sommes en l'an 3000 après J.C. et la Terre est perdue pour la race extraterrestre des Psychlos. L'humanité est asservie par ces tyrans avides d'or, qui ne savent pas que leurs « hommes-animaux » sont sur le point de déclencher la rébellion la plus importante de leur vie.

programme.title: The Dependables
programme.desc: Quatre anciens militaires à la retraite et un autre retraité tentent l'impensable et dépoussièrent leurs vieux uniformes pour une dernière mission explosive à la rescousse de leurs petits-enfants.

programme.title: Moving Target
programme.desc: Un chasseur de primes dont la femme enceinte le pousse à trouver un emploi régulier se fait piéger pour meurtre dans une guerre entre gangsters russes.

programme.title: Ciel de Feu
programme.desc: Malgré les avertissements du scientifique Nathan, son patron poursuit une expérience destinée à faire de la publicité pour sa société de satellites : faire exploser un astéroïde. Au lieu de cela, l'astéroïde se divise et le plus gros morceau, de la taille de l'Islande, change de trajectoire et se dirige vers la Terre. Il est dévié, mais si près qu'il nous rapproche du soleil, provoquant un réchauffement rapide et extrême qui, espérons-le, ne sera que de courte durée. Nathan prévient sa sœur, la journaliste Carly, et son amant, l'inspecteur de police Tom. Il emmène sa fille turbulente Kim, son ex-amant C.J. et sa mère, l'infirmière Bonnie, lorsque Nathan propose un vol vers la station météorologique arctique d'un ami. Tom prend en charge un dangereux voyage vers l'aéroport, alors que partout sur terre les choses prennent feu et que les gens se battent pour l'eau, le transport et le pillage pur et simple.

programme.title: My Soul To Take
programme.desc: Dans la petite ville de Riverton, la légende clame qu'un serial killer a juré de revenir assassiner les sept enfants nés la nuit où il est mort. Aujourd'hui, seize ans plus tard, de nouvelles personnes disparaissent. Le psychopathe s'est-il réincarné dans l'un des sept ados, ou a-t-il survécu à cette nuit où il fut laissé pour mort ?

programme.title: Act Of Valor
programme.desc: Des militaires doivent entamer une mission pour venir à la rescousse d'un agent de la CIA, pendant laquelle ils découvrent un complot terroriste à l'échelle mondiale contre les États-Unis. Ils font tout pour déjouer cette tentative sans risquer trop de pertes.

programme.title: Odd Thomas
programme.desc: Pico Mundo en Californie. Jeune cuisinier dans un grill d'une petite ville de l'Amérique profonde, Odd Thomas rêve d'être un garçon ordinaire. Mais il est pourvu d'un don encombrant : les morts communiquent avec lui. Parfois les âmes en peine veulent que Odd leur fasse justice. Parfois, elles lui donnent un tuyau afin qu'il puisse déjouer un meurtre avant qu'il ne se produise. Mais cette fois, c'est différent : un étranger débarque à Pico Mundo, accompagné d'une horde de créatures d'ombres, avides comme des hyènes - signe d'une catastrophe imminente. Avec l'aide de sa compagne, Stormy Llewellyn, Odd va se lancer dans une course contre la montre pour empêcher le drame.

programme.title: Redacted
programme.desc: Redacted raconte une histoire fictive inspirée de faits réels. C'est une expérience unique qui nous obligera à réexaminer de manière radicale les filtres à travers lesquels nous voyons et acceptons les événements mondiaux, le pouvoir de l'image médiatisée et l'influence exercée par la présentation des images sur ce que nous pensons et ce que nous croyons. Le film se concentre sur un petit groupe de soldats américains en garnison à un poste de contrôle en Irak. La succession de points de vue différents permet de confronter l'expérience de ces jeunes hommes sous pression, de journalistes et collaborateurs des médias avec celle de la communauté irakienne locale afin de faire la lumière sur les conséquences désastreuses que le conflit actuel et leur rencontre fortuite ont eues sur chacun d'eux.

programme.title: Red eagle
programme.desc: Bangkok 2016. Le gouvernement corrompu impose la construction d'une centrale nucléaire à des villageois hostiles à ce projet et réprime les manifestations anti-nucléaires menées notamment par Vasana Tienpradap, ex-fiancée du premier ministre. Red Eagle, un mystérieux justicier masqué, va affronter une organisation secrète d'hommes politiques qui poussent à l'édification de la centrale pour leurs propres intérêts financiers personnels.

programme.title: Snow in paradise
programme.desc: Dave, voyou londonien, se laisse persuader par son oncle de l'aider dans un trafic de drogues. Il demande à son ami Tariq de l'accompagner. Suite à cette expérience, Tariq disparaît. Dave s'enfonce dans la toxicomanie et se tourne vers l'Islam pour s'en sortir.

programme.title: Tokyo tribe
programme.desc: Dans un Tokyo futuriste, une immense guerre des gangs fait rage et divise la ville en quatre clans qui veulent imposer leurs règles. A la tête de deux bandes, deux anciens amis rivalisent et les rancoeurs et sentiments personnels viennent se mêler aux affrontements des hommes dans un chaos toujours grandissant.

programme.title: Aftershock, l'enfer sur terre
programme.desc: Valparaiso, paradis des fêtards en tout genre, venus au Chili pour vivre leurs excès jusqu'au bout de la nuit... Sauf que ce soir-là, un tremblement de terre ensevelit sous les décombre les clients d'une énorme boîte de nuit. Le Gringo et ses amis avaient eu la mauvaise idée de venir y passer la soirée. Pour les survivants, commence alors la longue quête vers la sortie de l'enfer. Malheureusement, les prisonniers d'un pénitencier voisin, (lui aussi détruit par le séisme), vont venir ajouter de l'horreur au chaos...

programme.title: Arkansas
programme.desc: Kyle (Liam Hemsworth) et Swin (Clark Duke) vivent sous les ordres d'un baron de la drogue d'Arkansas appelé Frog (Vince Vaughn). Quand une série d'erreurs les force à affronter Frog, Kyle et Swin doivent le tuer ou mourir.

programme.title: Les colocataires
programme.desc: Scott se retrouve seul et célibataire après que sa petite amie l'a largué en pleine demande en mariage et que son colocataire a déménagé à des milliers de kilomètres.

programme.title: Amityville 3D: Le démon
programme.desc: La redoutable maison d'Amityville est de nouveau agitée par la terreur. John Baxter, un journaliste sceptique, est le dernier acheteur de la maison la plus effrayante sur terre malgré la légende voulant que cette demeure soit hantée. Alors que Lisa l'aide dans la recherche de la vérité au sujet de cette maison, le couple découvre qu'il serait préférable que certains endroits restent inexplorés.

programme.title: Boogeyman: La Porte des cauchemars
programme.desc: Un homme essaie de se débarrasser de visions horribles et commence à soupçonner que ce qu'il voit sont de sombres souvenirs d'enfance.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: Le récit inspirant de l'entraîneur de basket-ball Ken Carter, qui reçut des éloges aussi bien que des critiques pour avoir annulé tous les matches de son équipe, alors invaincue, en raison de leurs mauvais résultats scolaires.

programme.title: Sex Friends
programme.desc: L'histoire désopilante de l'accord parfait que passent Emma et Adam, basé entièrement sur le sexe et dont la seule règle est : Sex Friends.

programme.title: American Heist
programme.desc: Le frère aîné de James, Frankie, sort de dix ans de prison. Il compte bien reprendre les affaires, au grand dam de James, qui est entraîné contre son gré par Frankie dans ce qui est censé être un petit coup avec une bande de malfrats.

programme.title: The Colony
programme.desc: Une période glaciaire a rayé de la carte une partie l'humanité. Les survivants doivent vivre dans des bunkers isolés. Lorsqu'une colonie ne donne plus signe de vie, Sam et Briggs montent...

programme.title: Accidents
programme.desc: Après un accident mortel dans une mine, un adolescent disparaît dans des circonstances mystérieuses. Cela va rapprocher un mineur survivant, la femme d'un des dirigeants de la mine et un adolescent solitaire, et mettre au grand jour un terrible secret...

programme.title: Ainsi Va la Vie
programme.desc: Oren, agent immobilier bourru, voit sa vie bouleversée quand il doit s'occuper de sa petite-fille de 9 ans.

programme.title: Serieously Ep.24
programme.desc: Ton rendez-vous francophone préféré sur les séries, le cinéma et la pop culture en général!

programme.title: Le Livre de l'amour
programme.desc: Henry, architecte introverti, aide Millie, une ado sans abri, à construire un radeau pour traverser l'Atlantique.

programme.desc: Ton rendez-vous francophone préféré sur les séries, le cinéma et la pop culture en général!

programme.desc: Écran Large : actu ciné, séries, comics, jeux vidéo

programme.title: Entre les jambes
programme.desc: Tout commence lors d'une réunion des sexopathes anonymes où Javier et Miranda se rencontrent. Javier, scénariste-producteur, avait un avenir brillant jusqu'au jour où il s'est livré à un jeu sexuel au téléphone qui a détruit son mariage et Miranda, animatrice d'une émission radio.

programme.title: Juste un peu d'alchimie
programme.desc: Oli tombe amoureuse d'Eric, une étoile brillante du cinéma et de la télévision. Elle va vivre une merveilleuse romance dans un monde de glamour.

programme.title: Comment j'ai kidnappé mon boss
programme.desc: Plongez dans la comédie loufoque d'Anna, mère célibataire de deux enfants, qui, pour éviter de se faire licencier par son patron amnésique, va lui faire croire qu'il est le père de ses enfants... Une histoire drôle et romantique, à partager en famille !

programme.title: Ma super ex
programme.desc: Gauche, Matt voit sa rencontre avec Jenny (qui est en fait G-Girl) comme un cadeau. Mais quand il décide de rompre, il se retrouve confronté à une super-héroïne super rancunière.

programme.title: Alone together
programme.desc: June, critique gastronomique, se rend dans le nord de l'État de New York pour une courte escapade romantique afin d'échapper à la pandémie qui sévit en ville.

programme.title: La liberté à tout prix
programme.desc: Allemagne de l'Est, 1984 : Frank Korbach se réjouit de fréquenter l'école d'art dramatique, tandis que son meilleur ami rebelle Thomas refuse de faire son service militaire. Avec l'aventureux mais naïf Alex, Thomas projette de faire une tentative désespérée de fuite vers l'Ouest. Sachant qu'il ne les reverra peut-être jamais, Frank accompagne Thomas et Alex à la frontière. Soudain, ils sont confrontés à une unité spéciale de la Stasi, la police secrète est-allemande. Bien que les garçons parviennent à éviter la capture, l'ancienne vie de Frank a disparu à jamais - il est maintenant devenu un fugitif. Le père de Frank, Kurt Korbach, est stupéfait par cette évasion. Kurt est un major de la Stasi, à l'insu de son fils. Convaincu que Frank est innocent, il persuade ses supérieurs que lui seul peut ramener son fils. Avec le suspect colonel Frey - une bombe à retardement prête à exploser - Kurt se met en route pour retrouver les garçons en fuite.

programme.title: Arrête ton cinéma!
programme.desc: Mettant de côté sa carrière d'actrice et sa famille, Sybille plonge dans son nouveau rôle de directrice. Mais lorsqu'elle est forcée d'exécuter sans cesse les changements exigés par les producteurs, son rêve devient un cauchemar.

programme.title: Taj Mahal
programme.desc: À 18 ans, Louise loge avec sa famille dans une suite du Taj Mahal Palace. Un soir, restée seule dans sa chambre, elle entend des bruits étranges dans les couloirs de l'hôtel. Elle comprend au bout de quelques minutes qu'il s'agit d'une attaque terroriste.

programme.title: Ma Fille Kidnappée!
programme.desc: Après que Teri, une voisine, ait proposé de "garder" sa fille et que celle-ci ait disparu, Susan, une mère, devra revenir sur la mort de son mari pour la sauver.

programme.title: Bienvenue à Acapulco
programme.desc: Un développeur de jeux vidéo doit se rendre au nouveau mexique pour le travail mais se trompe d'avion et se retrouve au mexique. Les choses se gâtent alors une fois à acapulco…

programme.title: The New Captain Scarlet
programme.desc: The New Captain Scarlet - Épisode 10: Situé en 2068, Captain Scarlet suit la "guerre psychologique" entre la Terre et les Mysterons, une race martienne qui possède un contrôle partiel sur la matière. Lorsqu'un malentendu pousse des astronautes humains à attaquer leur ville sur Mars, les Mysterons jurent de se venger et lancent une série de représailles contre la Terre.

programme.title: Being Light
programme.desc: Maxime, un jeune homme de 25 ans, débarque à Paris, mais souhaite rejoindre Justine, la femme qu'il aime, en Inde. Au bar de l'hôtel Raphaël, il fait la connaissance de Jack Lesterhoof, un riche homme d'affaires. Maxime accepte. Les deux hommes deviennent bientôt amis. Jack décide de faire un break, de rompre avec la routine et d'accompagner Maxime en Inde.

programme.title: A Magic Puppy
programme.desc: Adam adore les films d'horreur. C'est une passion qu'il partage avec son amie Molly, qui est secrètement amoureuse de lui. A la suite d'un extraordinaire concours de circonstances, Adam transforme Ted, le petit ami de sa mère, en chien ! Adam et Molly n'auront que quelques jours pour rendre à Ted son aspect initial.

programme.title: Horatio, un Ami Extraordinaire
programme.desc: Depuis que son père est mort, 16 ans, Juliette, sa belle-mère et ses deux demi-frères luttent pour garder leur ranch. Mais Juliette pense qu'elle a un secret qui pourrait garder le ranch ouvert: son cheval, Horatio, peut parler!

programme.title: Bienvenue à Acapulco
programme.desc: Un développeur de jeux vidéo doit se rendre au nouveau mexique pour le travail mais se trompe d'avion et se retrouve au mexique. Les choses se gâtent alors une fois à acapulco…

programme.title: Un Jour Sans Fin
programme.desc: Phil Connors, journaliste à la télévision et responsable de la météo part faire son reportage annuel dans la bourgade de Punxsutawney où l'on fête le "Groundhog Day" : "Jour de la marmotte". Dans l'impossibilité de rentrer chez lui ensuite à Pittsburgh pour cause d'intempéries il se voit forcé de passer une nuit de plus dans cette ville perdue.

programme.title: Les ex de mon mec
programme.desc: Stacy, une jeune journaliste en herbe, découvre, en regardant dans l'organizer électronique de son petit ami, qu'il a eu avant elle une suite de relations sentimentales incroyables avec, entre autres, un superbe mannequin et la voisine de palier. Elle décide de toutes les rencontrer...

programme.title: Camping Car
programme.desc: Pour Bob Munro, sa femme Jamie et leurs deux enfants, il devient urgent de resserrer les liens, sous peine de voir leur famille exploser. Bob avait promis d'emmener tout le monde à Hawaii, mais il a brusquement décidé qu'un long périple en camping-car serait bien plus excitant... Jamie et les enfants ne passent pas vraiment les vacances qu'ils espéraient.

programme.title: Ma Vie Sans Lui
programme.desc: Une jeune femme doit faire face à la mort de son mari et à la découverte de nombreux secrets le concernant...

programme.title: Allez les filles!
programme.desc: La manager d'un “café des sports formes incluses” au bord de l'autoroute consacre tout son optimisme et sa foi à ses serveuses, ses clients et à elle-même, au cours d'une longue et étrange journée durant laquelle sa patience est mise à l'épreuve.

programme.title: Bloody Hell
programme.desc: Un homme au passé mystérieux fuit son pays pour échapper à son propre enfer. Malheureusement pour lui, ses ennuis ne font que débuter.

programme.title: Rosalie Blum
programme.desc: Vincent Machot connaît sa vie par cœur. Il la partage entre son salon de coiffure, son cousin, son chat, et sa mère bien trop envahissante. Mais la vie réserve parfois des surprises, même aux plus prudents... il croise par hasard Rosalie Blum...

programme.title: Afternoon delight
programme.desc: Soucieuse de pimenter son mariage, Rachel emmène son mari dans une boîte de strip-tease où ils y rencontrent, une strip-teaseuse et décide de l'embaucher comme nounou ...

programme.title: Votre programme reprendra rapidement
programme.desc: Nous nous refaisons une beauté ! Restez à l'écoute pour d'autres divertissements inestimables sélectionnés par Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Le plan d'Amber
programme.desc: Irlande, milieu des années 90. Eddie et Amber se font passer pour un couple afin de faire taire les rumeurs qui circulent autour de leur sexualité.

programme.title: Hercule contre les tyrans de Babylone
programme.desc: Le roi Shalmaneser, Assur et sa sœur sorcière Tanit, tyrans de Babylone, retiennent prisonniers des Hellènes, dont Esperia, reine d'Hellas. Hercule intervient pour la sauver, punir les tyrans cruels et libérer le peuple.

programme.title: Au-delà de la haine
programme.desc: Une famille de pionniers est presque entièrement détruite par des Indiens en quête de vengeance : Le petit George est laissé évanoui sur le sol, et sa petite sœur adoptée par le chef indien. Le destin les réunira à nouveau.

programme.title: Le temps du massacre
programme.desc: Un chercheur d'or et son demi-frère ivrogne doivent affronter un fermier et son fils sadique après avoir pris le contrôle de sa ferme.

programme.title: Amigo!... Mon colt a deux mots à te dire
programme.desc: Un vagabond aux poings rapides et un proxénète armé de pistolets rapides aident un enfant à réclamer son héritage.

programme.title: Night Caller
programme.desc: Une médium se retrouve prise dans un jeu du chat et de la souris malsain avec un tueur en série qui lui téléphone avant chacun de ses meurtres.

programme.title: Compulsion
programme.desc: Amy, est une chef cuisinière qui rêve d'avoir son propre show télévisé culinaire. Elle est jalouse de sa voisine de palier, Saffron, qui est quant à elle une ancienne enfant star. Les deux femmes, souffrent de troubles obsessionnels à des degrés différents, elles vont confronter leurs univers intimes dans une bataille de volontés face à leurs troubles alimentaires et sexuels.

programme.title: Pterodactyl
programme.desc: Tandis qu'un commando d'élite de l'armée américaine tend une embuscade à des rebelles, le professeur Lovecraft guide plusieurs de ses élèves dans une mission archéologique. Une étudiante est attaquée par un ptérodactyle.

programme.title: Les Nouveaux Vampires
programme.desc: Un savant met au point un sérum capable de transformer les humains en vampire. Une des victimes résiste au sérum et tente d'arrêter le savant et ses acolytes avant qu'il ne contamine le monde.

programme.title: Mémoires Diaboliques
programme.desc: Lea, une femme napolitaine d'âge mûr vivant dans une ville du nord du pays, a eu treize enfants, tous morts à l'exception de Michele pour qui elle a une affection morbide, convaincue qu'elle l'a volé à la mort.

programme.title: Les dieux des profondeurs
programme.desc: Lorsqu'une mission audacieuse conduit une équipe de sous-marin en eaux profondes dans une mystérieuse ouverture au fond de l'océan, ils découvrent un monde sous-marin perdu et réveillent son ancienne race d'êtres d'un autre monde...

programme.title: Sea Fever
programme.desc: Dans le cadre de ses études, Siobhán, étudiante en biologie marine, doit passer une semaine sur un vieux chalutier. Peu de temps après leur départ en mer, une forme de vie inconnue enserre le navire, l'immobilisant au beau milieu de l'Atlantique.

programme.title: Enlèvement
programme.desc: À la recherche d'une femme disparue dans le Dakota du Nord, un agent du FBI et un shérif se concentrent sur son mari, un fanatique religieux, mais découvrent quelque chose de bien plus sinistre.

programme.title: Age of Dinosaurs
programme.desc: Une firme de biotechnologie met au point une technique révolutionnaire de régénération de la peau, capable de recréer de vrais dinosaures vivants.

programme.title: Les évadés de Maze
programme.desc: 1983, Irlande du Nord. Maze est l'une des prisons de haute-sécurité les mieux gardées d'Europe. Larry Marley élabore un incroyable plan dans le but de s'évader avec ses camarades de l'IRA…

programme.title: The cake heaters
programme.desc: Deux familles se retrouvent à l'occasion du retour de l'un des fils. Mais ces retrouvailles vont faire réapparaître de vieux fantômes.

programme.title: La mort dans l'âme
programme.desc: Marc Lagnier avoue le meurtre de son fils adoré, mais refuse de s'expliquer.

programme.title: Ainsi va la vie
programme.desc: Lorsqu'il se retrouve soudain en charge de sa petite-fille dont il ignorait l'existence jusqu'à ce que son fils éloigné la dépose chez lui, un agent immobilier égoïste demande l'aide de son voisin.

programme.title: The Thompsons
programme.desc: En fuite, la famille de vampires la plus angoissée d'Amérique se rend en Angleterre à la recherche d'un ancien clan de vampires. Ce qu'ils trouvent à la place pourrait déchirer leur famille et les égorger à jamais.

programme.title: Bad Samaritan
programme.desc: Des cambrioleurs tombent sur une femme retenue en captivité dans une maison qu'ils avaient l'intention de voler.

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: Un rite d'initiation d'une fraternité universitaire tourne mal. Un étudiant blessé par balle et une employée de supérette kidnappée se retrouvent au foyer de la fraternité. La panique persiste.

programme.title: Jack Strong
programme.desc: L'espion polonais le plus spectaculaire de l'époque de la guerre froide, le colonel Ryszard Kuklinski, informe les Américains des plus grands secrets du bloc communiste face à l'imminence de la loi martiale.

programme.title: Vigilante
programme.desc: Fou de rage après l'agression de son épouse et le meurtre de son fils et écœuré par le laxisme et la corruption des autorités, qui ont permis aux responsables d'être libérés, un électricien new-yorkais s'acoquine avec un groupe d'auto-défense, dans lequel il refusait d'entrer jusqu'alors, afin de venger sa famille.

programme.title: In Search of Darkness
programme.desc: Plongez dans l'horreur des années 80 avec cette conclusion gargantuesque qui s'attaque à l'âge d'or de la VHS et des vidéoclubs, dresse les portraits d'artistes et artisans incontournables et aborde de nombreuses pépites oubliées d'un cinéma imaginatif, sanglant, expérimental, indispensable…

programme.title: Maniac
programme.desc: Traumatisé par les mauvais traitements qui lui faisait subir sa mère, Frank hante les rues de New York à la recherche de jeunes femmes dont il prélève le scalp. Sa rencontre avec une jeune photographe lui permettra-t-elle de contenir ses pulsions homicides ?

programme.title: Uberlinks
programme.desc: Claude et Mahalia ont matché sur une application de rencontre pour personnes dotées de super-pouvoirs. Celui de Claude ? Devenir invisible. Quand Mahalia insiste pour connaître sa première action à la découverte de son pouvoir, Claude fait tout pour fuir la question. De peur de ruiner ses chances avec elle.

programme.title: Totem VF
programme.desc: Buffle, un ancien scout, n'a toujours pas fait le deuil de son ami disparu il y a vingt ans. En plus de cela, il est constamment hanté par un rat géant… Sa psychologue lui conseille de reformer sa bande en organisant un camp. Mais cette thérapie de groupe va prendre une nouvelle dimension lorsque que nos quadragénaires vont découvrir un passage temporel.

programme.title: Contracted
programme.desc: Après une nuit avec un inconnu, Samantha subit une lente décomposition.

programme.title: Contracted Phase II
programme.desc: Infecté par un virus, un homme lutte pour empêcher lépidémie de se propager.

programme.title: Dementia
programme.desc: Un vétéran atteint de démence découvre que son infirmière cache de terribles secrets.

programme.title: Cosmoball
programme.desc: Un immense vaisseau accueille une compétition de sport spatial appelé Cosmoball.

programme.title: Memoire Effacee
programme.desc: Hantée par la mort de son fils, Telly s'entend affirmer par un psychiatre que l'enfant n'a jamais existé, et qu'elle est victime d'hallucinations. Et elle ne retrouve effectivement aucune trace du disparu... En compagne d'Ash, qui a aussi perdu son enfant dans le même crash aérien, Telly va tenter de faire éclater la vérité

programme.title: Don't Breathe 2
programme.desc: The sequel is set in the years following the initial deadly home invasion, where Norman Nordstrom (Stephen Lang) lives in quiet solace until his past sins catch up to him.

programme.title: Obsessed
programme.desc: Un homme, heureux dans son couple et dans sa carrière, voit sa vie basculer le jour où une intérimaire commence à le suivre partout.

programme.title: Hanna
programme.desc: Hanna (SAOIARSE RONAN) a 16 ans. Elle est intelligente, curieuse, jolie - et se révèle être un assassin professionnel. Ayant passé presque toute sa vie dans la toundra à apprendre des techniques de combat enseignées par son père (ERIC BANA), elle revient à la civilisation où un agent sans scrupules de la CIA (CATE BLANCHETT) tente de la faire disparaître. Tout en apprenant comment elle est devenue une machine à tuer, Hanna doit se battre pour survivre et finalement, éliminer la personne qui est responsable de ce qu'elle est devenue.

programme.title: The Run
programme.desc: Un entraîneur d'athlétisme reclus rencontre un adolescent pauvre, qui est à un tournant violent dans sa vie, et façonne le garçon en un coureur de classe mondiale.

programme.title: House of Boys
programme.desc: Amsterdam, 1984, Frank a 18 ans et décide de quitter le domicile familial pour s'émanciper et vivre sa vie comme il l'entend. Pour survivre, Il devient alors danseur dans le club de strip-tease " House of Boys ".

programme.title: Jack Strong
programme.desc: Décembre 1970, Gdansk. La grève du chantier naval est brutalement stoppée par les tirs de l'armée polonaise. Promis aux plus hautes fonctions, le colonel Ryszard Kulinski est profondément marqué par cette sanglante répression.

programme.title: Coldwater
programme.desc: Brad est un adolescent impliqué dans plusieurs petits délits. Ses parents décident de le faire emmener de force dans le camp de redressement pour mineurs très isolé de Coldwater.

programme.title: Two Warriors : Le Combat du Siècle
programme.desc: Tokyo, peu après la seconde Guerre Mondiale. Un champion de boxe japonais jusque là invaincu se prépare à affronter un challenger américain.

programme.title: No Way Back
programme.desc: Dans un affrontement entre des hommes du FBI et une équipe néo-nazie, le fils du gangster Serlano meurt. Il kidnappe le fils d'un agent pour proposer un échange à la police et se venger d'un chef de la mafia, prétendument responsable du meurtre.

programme.title: Attaque programmée
programme.desc: Lu Zi Ming, expert en sécurité, est engagé pour travailler lors d'un événement d'appel d'offres pour un projet d'usine pétrolière et gazière. Il est piégé par plusieurs des parties prenantes. Afin de prouver son innocence, il doit maintenant concevoir la contre-attaque ultime.

programme.title: The Swordsman
programme.desc: Corée, 1623. Afin de sauver sa fille Tae-Ok, enlevée par des marchands d'esclaves à la solde des nouveaux Maîtres chinois Qing, doit reprendre l'épée qu'il avait abandonnée après la chute du roi Gwanghaegun.

programme.title: Sacrifice
programme.desc: Obsédé par la mort récente de sa femme et de sa fille, John Hebron tente de se raccrocher à sa carrière de policier entre deux verres de whisky. Venu chercher conseil auprès du père Porter, dont l'église vient d'être saccagée...

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E4
programme.desc: Although the date hasn't been set, Tony forbids Jeannie from accompanying Melissa and himself on their honeymoon. Grover Caldwell, a young State Department attaché, tells Tony that General Stone, Melissa's father, has accepted an ambassadorial post. General Stone announces he hopes to take Tony, his prospective son-in-law, along as his military aide. When Tony expresses his desire to remain with the space program, Melissa, who has been working to advance the marriage date, tells her father she will change Tony's mind. She suggests that Grover replace Roger as Tony's best man.Jeannie, determined to accompany Tony, prepares an oriental feast when Melissa and her father dine at Tony's. Before serving, Jeannie turns herself into a Filipino houseboy. Melissa suggests they take the houseboy to Europe with them. Tony is given a bachelor dinner in which Jeannie emerges dancing from a prop cake. Jeannie learns that Grover is an old boy friend of Melissa's. Before Jeannie is through, Grover tells Melissa he loves her. Tony is not completely unhappy to be left with Jeannie, when Grover and Melissa declare their intentions to marry.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E5
programme.desc: Jeannie gets jealous on discovering that Tony has a sexy new secretary. Claiming to be a better one, Jeannie insists on joining the WAAFs and taking over the job. Remembering that his friend, Roger Healey, told him that all new WAAFs are being sent overseas, Tony agrees to help Jeannie to join. To her horror, she is sent to San Antonio for basic training. Jeannie has a series of disastrous tryouts in different job categories, in spite of her insistence that she wants an assignment as Captain Nelson's secretary when she becomes a WAAF.When Major Margaret Fiefeld assigns Jeannie as secretary to the commanding officer at the North African base instead, Jeannie folds her arms, blinks, and lands in Tony's office. Tony informs Jeannie that he is being sent to Nevada. Jeannie says she will resign and go with him. Tony then tells her that only troublesome, incompetent girls are discharged and that she cannot resign. Jeannie blinks again, the office is set is turmoil, and Tony resignedly welcomes Jeannie back to civilian life.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E6
programme.desc: After promising to spend an evening with Jeannie, Tony is tricked by his superiors into conducting aerospace tycoon P.J. Ferguson on a tour of the base. Ferguson's daughter, Nina, de-cides that Tony is her man. P.J. persuades Tony's superior to order Tony to have cocktails aboard his yacht. When Jeannie protests, Tony imprisons her in the vacuum cleaner. Later, after P.J. has Tony assigned to a cruise on his yacht, Mrs. Flaherty, Tony's cleaning woman, accidentally releases Jeannie from the vacuum cleaner. She immediately takes off for the yacht.Jeannie disappears from the yacht during an argument with Tony. Nina and P.J. are certain he has pushed her overboard. Charged with murder, Tony is arrested. Roger Healey, certain Tony has lost his mind, agrees to go to Tony's house and tell the walls and the vacuum cleaner of Tony's plight, Jeannie goes to Tony's cell. Her appearance convinces P.J. that Tony is innocent. Later, searching for privacy, Jeannie and Tony climb into her bottle.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E7
programme.desc: After telling Tony that he and Roger Healey have been tapped for a historic two-man space probe, scheduled to blast off the following week, Dr. Bellows asks him to report for a final check-up. When Tony asks Jeannie to return to her home, Jeannie asserts that since Tony freed her from the bottle, she belongs to him. She adds that she can give him a space capsule of his own. Tony tells Jeannie if he fails tomorrow's test, he will not go on the flight.Worried about Tony's safety, Jeannie causes him to blurt out the wrong answers to every test. Tony leaves Dr. Bellows, certain he has passed, but Jeannie tells him he has failed. Impressed by Tony's unhappiness, Jeannie goes to Dr. Bellows' office, where he is typing a report on Tony's unfortunate condition. Resorting to all her magic, Jeannie makes Bellows believe that he is not only losing his mind, but is near death. Tony is reassigned to the two-man flight. There, in outer space, Jeannie joins Tony as he floats from a tether attached to the capsule.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E8
programme.desc: Feeling that Jeannie must widen her horizons, Tony gives her a book "How To Be A Woman." Following the book's advice, to share her work with her man, Jeannie neglects her chores and allows the house to go to pot. Reading the chapter on clothing the successful woman, Jeannie charges an expensive wardrobe, in-cluding a mink coat. Convinced by the book that a man should take the woman out to dinner, Jeannie steers Tony to expensive Cafe Scheherazade. She starts a row when she criticizes the authen-ticity of the Arabian dancing.Literally taking the author's advice, Jeannie becomes a career girl and performs miraculous feats of instantaneous cooking while demonstrating electric stoves. Her employer, Sam, feeling she has been planted to get him into trouble with the Better Business Bureau, fires her. Later, after Tony feels he has straightened out things at home, Jeannie hears a news report about the flight of a Russian female astronaut. Blinking her eyes, she is outfitted as an astronaut and insists on accompanying Tony into space.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E9
programme.desc: Tony is assigned as technical director on a new astronaut movie being filmed in Hollywood. Jealous of the star, Rita Mitchell, Jeannie smuggles herself along. All of Jeannie's ruses, including a rainstorm, fail to keep Tony from getting close to Rita. Tony tells Jeannie he is lunching with Rita and jokingly tells Jeannie he would lunch with her instead if she were a star. Determined to become a movie celebrity, Jeannie, seeing a picture of Pola Negri, patterns her personality on the old-time vamp.Although her first try at getting into the movies is viewed as a gag, Jeannie manages to get a screen test with Jason Huberts, which arouses Tony's jealousy. When the test with Jason and Jeannie is shown, only Jason is visible and Jeannie suddenly realizes that genies do not register on film. She is consoled when Tony breaks a date with Rita and they register their footprints in front of Grauman's Chinese with all the movie greats.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E10
programme.desc: Jeannie gets involved with the law when, invisible to everyone, she attempts to drive Tony's car. Angered, Tony orders her to leave. Jeannie is aware that Tony has been studying the desalinization of seawater. Playing for time, she tells Tony her great-grandfather solved the problem. Tony asks to meet her great grandfather and Jeannie goes to get him. Tony phones Leslie Staples at the Department of Agriculture and tells him he is on the verge of converting salt water to fresh. Jeannie returns with her great grandfather, Bilejik, who proves that he can produce fresh water from salt water.When Tony returns to find Bilejik, Jeannie and a policeman are in front of his house. Bilejik has been causing all sorts of trouble with the neighbors. While resolving the matter, Tony discovers that Bilejik used seeds as a filter. After Bilejik leaves, Tony jubilantly reports to Staples. Staples tells him that these seeds are from a plant extinct for almost two thousand years.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E11
programme.desc: A series of reports by eleven-year-old Custer to his father, Major Ulysses S. Jamison, on the strange feats of magic at Tony's house results in the Major taking his son to Dr. Bellows, the base psychiatrist. Bellows tells Custer he believes his story, and asks him to keep a close watch on Tony. A policeman catches Dr. Bellows and Custer peering into Tony's window and takes them inside for identification. While Bellows is telling Tony that Custer believes he has seen them levitate, Jeannie causes him to do so. Bellows bows out, feeling he has stumbled on a top-secret aerospace project.Tony voices his nervousness to Jeannie about being spied on by Custer. When Custer disappears, Tony accuses Jeannie of turning him into nothing. Angered, Jeannie leaves. Later, when Custer comes back, having spent the day at a carnival, Tony penitently begins searching for Jeannie. He is sure Jeannie has joined a carnival act and starts a riot at the sideshow when he mistakes a veiled woman for Jeannie. Jeannie returns home and starts pulling down all the shades to outwit Custer.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E12
programme.desc: Jeannie is annoyed when Diane Rodney, a friend of Tony's, returns to town, determined to resume their old relationship. As a result, when Jeannie runs into Roger, while driving Tony's car, she accepts his invitation to dinner. Unaware that Jeannie is Roger's date, Tony instructs his friend in the fine art of courtship. Later, when Jeannie tells him she doesn't know her date's name, Tony begins to worry. When Diane arrives, Tony drags her all over town searching for Jeannie. The two couples finally meet at a nightclub. Alone with Jeannie, Tony demands she return home. Jeannie tells him she is going to listen to Roger's records.At Roger's apartment, Jeannie wards off all his attempts at romance. She leaves shortly before Tony pounds on the door looking for her. Tony points out to Roger all the mistakes he would be making if he married her. Convinced, Roger admits Tony has saved him from making a fool of himself. Jeannie is overjoyed by Tony's concern for her. Tony replies that, after all, he is only human.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E13
programme.desc: Jeannie agrees not to date Roger if Tony doesn't go out with other girls. Then Tony and Roger are assigned to escort Russian cosmonauts Major Tiomkin and Major Posnovsky during a goodwill visit. Major Tiomkin proves to be a beautiful girl named Sonya, who immediately stakes a claim on Tony. Angered, Jeannie tells Tony she is going out with Roger. Tony imprisons Jeannie in her bottle. Jeannie maneuvers the bottle into the pocket of Roger's raincoat. Roger presents the bottle to Sonya. Tony gets involved in a fracas with General Barkley and Dr. Bellows in his unsuccessful try to get the bottle back. When Sonya opens the bottle, Jeannie appears. Pointing to Sonya as her new mistress, she tells the cosmonaut she can make her every wish come true.When the plane on which Sonya is scheduled to return leaves, Tony feels her country now has possession of a decisive secret weapon. Later, dripping furs and jewelry, Sonya comes to Tony's home. She tells him Jeannie has granted her fondest desire by turning her into a wealthy American. Sonya agrees to return the bottle if Tony marries her. Tony asks a last word with Jeannie. He tells Jeannie he can't marry Sonya. Jeannie solves the problem by creating a duplicate Tony for Sonya.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E14
programme.desc: Unable to persuade Tony to marry her, Jeannie decides she needs a mother's counsel. She blinks her eyes and Mama appears. Mama assures Jeannie Tony will change his mind if he thinks Jeannie is going to marry Roger. Tony asks Roger if he has met Jeannie's parents. Then Dr. Bellows announces he has bought the lot across the street. Roger asks to meet Jeannie's parents. She produces a house on Dr. Bellows' lot. Tony sees Dr. Bellows and General Hadley approaching the lot. Responding to Tony's pleas, Jeannie makes the house vanish. General Hadley and Dr. Bellows see Tony sitting in the weeds sipping tea. Making the house reappear, Jeannie produces parents for Roger's visit.Tony comes to the house and forbids Jeannie to marry Roger. Then Dr. Bellows drives up. Seeing the house, he becomes distraught, and runs to Tony. As the house disappears again, they see Roger sitting in the weeds. The following day, Roger tells Tony he found himself wandering around a vacant lot. When he returned to apologize, Jeannie and the house were gone. Smiling at Jeannie, hiding in his desk drawer, Tony assures Roger he Will let him know if he ever meets Jeannie again.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E15
programme.desc: Learning that Dr. Bellows has told General Peterson that Tony should marry for his emotional stability as an astronaut, Jeannie prepares for the wedding. She produces Phoney, a twin of Tony's, who starts romancing her as an example for Tony. Getting nowhere, Jeannie makes Phoney disappear. Later, Dr. Bellows sees a romantic interlude between Jeannie and Phoney and leaves Tony's house, certain a wedding has been set for the following Sunday afternoon. Although Tony tries to get out of his predicament, he realizes he is stuck when the General congratulates him on his coming wedding. Later, Tony tells Jeannie he is going through with the affair.Jeannie produces Phoney to show Tony how to act at the wedding. Phoney tries to get Jeannie to marry him before she makes him vanish. At the chapel, Jeannie runs away at the last moment. At home, Tony tries unsuccessfully to make Jeannie believe it was actually Phoney who appeared at the wedding. Sure it was Tony, Jeannie tells she ran away after deciding never to force herself on him. When Tony musingly asks what would happen had they gotten married, Jeannie insinuates he will never know.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E16
programme.sub-title: Get Me To Mecca On Time
programme.desc: Jeannie finds her strength and power to perform magic weakening. Tony makes her promise to rest during the day. At the base, Roger, pointing to an astrological chart in a magazine, tells Tony his horoscope shows a gorgeous brunette will enter Roger's life. Tony questions his belief in such nonsense. Later, Jeannie phones Tony and tells him she seems to be vanishing by degrees. Then she pops into his office. Reading Roger's magazine, she tells Tony it is the Day of the Ram, on which every Genie and her master must pilgrimage to Mecca, and standing in a precise spot, repeat the Sacred Words. Tony refuses to take her seriously, but begins to wonder when Roger introduces him to Diane, a beautiful brunette. Tony and Jeannie take off for Mecca.Since the city has changed, they run into difficulty locating the place where they must pronounce the Sacred Words. They find the place they are looking for is now a bank and break in. As they are about to be taken by the police, Jeannie begins to fade. Tony finds the correct spot and pronounces the incantation. Jeannie recovers and they leave for home. Thanking Tony for saving her life, Jeannie announces she is taking them to Paris for dinner. Deciding they have traveled enough for one day, Tony takes her to Cocoa Beach instead.

programme.title: Signs of Evil
programme.desc: The symbol of the SS, Hitler's Schutzstaffel, stands for terror and the murder of millions. The penniless graphic artist Walter Heck was given the job of designing the jagged, rune-like characters in 1929. The “sig” rune was rooted deep in the ideological cosmos of the Nazis and their supporters. They saw themselves as the descendants of the Teutons and declared the runes to be humanity's original Germanic script. The symbol was meant to unite Heinrich Himmler's “Black Order.” But did it escape their notice that it was originally of Semitic origin? In October 1945, the Allies passed a law banning the Nazi Party and all associated organizations, including the SS. The young Federal Republic even forbade all Nazi symbols. This documentary tells the gripping story of the SS symbol, from the Middle Ages to the present day.

programme.title: Wild Warrior Encounters
programme.desc: In this episode the volunteers discover the community's role in conservation and give a hand with some of the building projects. Honey harvesting proves hair-raising for a number of volunteers, particularly Kristina, who has a bee sting phobia …. Who could blame her! A new addition bolsters the conservation efforts in the form of an amazing tracker dog called Merwe. This is a special Dutch Shepherd breed that has an incredible combination of a heightened sense of smell, speed and formidable teeth. It's always a privilege to be able to get close to black rhino and it can often be quite an emotional moment for some of the volunteers, as is the case with Jane who can't hold the tears back as she feeds Tafika for the last time.

programme.title: Wonderful Wetlands
programme.desc: Water is the key to life. It provides a haven for countless plants and animals, everything from water-loving cats and predatory birds to killer dragonflies and carnivorous foliage. It can be a nursery, a migration stopover and a larder. And there's place where water is gathered, drained and stored for all to enjoy – the wetland. Wetlands are some of the most remarkable ecosystems in the natural world everything from dragonflies and bats to fish and amphibians can thrive thanks to the wonderful wetland.

programme.title: Wild Portugal
programme.desc: Water is a vital element for the survival of all living beings on Planet Earth. Rivers are, therefore, real arteries for life. From the top of the mountains where the rivers begin to run, to their final destination, we will get to know the animals and landscapes that cross the heart of Wild Portugal.

programme.title: Wild Portugal
programme.desc: The richness of Portugal's coastal waters is amazing. Thousands of creatures live here, both in the water and on land. The portuguese coast is the ultimate frontier before the Atlantic Ocean. In the middle of the Atlantic, the archipelago of the Azores is home to one of the richest ocean ecosystems on the Planet. In this episode we will meet some of these species in a unique and revealing look at their lives.

programme.title: Epic Safari Encounters

programme.title: Wild Warrior Encounters

Getting dirty is part of the job as the volunteers tackle the paddock cleaning tasks. One of the highlights in this episode is attempting to catch and relocate a massive python that tried to eat Judy's dog and duiker!

programme.title: Wild Warrior Encounters
programme.desc: In this episode we witness a desperate mission to save a spooked impala that got it's leg caught in a fence. Luckily the volunteers reacted quickly and made a plan to help the impala. One of the highlights for any volunteer at Imire is to interact with the incredibly clever elephants. Daily training is done the elephants to hone their skills. It's hard to believe but these gentle giants can actually track poachers. And, there is always time for fun tasks. It is vital for the volunteers to bond with each other so the Imire management team, devise amazing fun tasks, including this one, whereby 2 teams are challenged to build their own raft and race across the dam. After many laughs there is one clear winner.

programme.title: Wild Warrior Encounters
programme.desc: In this episode the volunteers experience close up encounters with iconic creatures. It's not often people can experience a walk with elephants and really appreciate the size of these beasts. Giraffe also happen to wonder close which makes the experience even more epic. The volunteers get to handle paint ball guns to get an understanding of how the anti poaching team operates and it seems like Kristina is a pretty good shot! And, nothing stands in the way of hard work, as it's all hands on deck securing electric strands to a border fence. This will dramatically improve the security at Imire.

programme.title: Wild Warrior Encounters
programme.desc: In this episode the volunteers discover the community's role in conservation and give a hand with some of the building projects. Honey harvesting proves hair-raising for a number of volunteers, particularly Kristina, who has a bee sting phobia …. Who could blame her! A new addition bolsters the conservation efforts in the form of an amazing tracker dog called Merwe. This is a special Dutch Shepherd breed that has an incredible combination of a heightened sense of smell, speed and formidable teeth. It's always a privilege to be able to get close to black rhino and it can often be quite an emotional moment for some of the volunteers, as is the case with Jane who can't hold the tears back as she feeds Tafika for the last time.

programme.title: Last of the Right Whales
programme.desc: North Atlantic right whales are dying faster than they can reproduce. With less than 400 remaining, these great whales rarely die of natural causes. Instead they are run over by ships or suffer lethal injuries from fishing gear. If we don't stop killing them, in 20 years they could be extinct. From the only known calving grounds to the shifting feeding grounds, ‘Last of the Right Whales' follows the North Atlantic right whale migration and the people committed to saving a species still struggling to recover from centuries of hunting.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.desc: Nowhere is the American way of life as relaxed as on Florida's beaches. The Keys, a chain of islands at the far southern end of the state, reveal a more laid-back side of the USA. But all of Florida amazes -- with secluded beaches, unspoiled nature, and the legacy of the early European settlers.

programme.title: Jacques Cousteau's Legacy
programme.desc: A composition of wildlife footage, archive material and elaborate re-enactments results in a brilliant reconstruction of the life of famed marine biologist and environmental pioneer Jacques Cousteau. On the trail of the most famous oceanographer of the 20th Century, the team spent two years filming original locations on three different continents, in four different oceans. The film charts how Cousteau's outlook on the environment changed throughout his many decades at sea around the globe. On his personal journey to enlightenment, he changed from a man who killed sharks in hate and thoughtlessly blew up coral reefs, to a radical environmentalist.

programme.title: Wildlife Diaries Australia
programme.desc: The Cairns Turtle Rehabilitation Center (CTRC) raises and cares for sick, or injured turtles, while the Schmidt Ocean Institute goes on a diving mission with a high-tech underwater rover. In this way, we learn firsthand about the state of Australia's sensitive marine animals' natural habitat and what needs to be done to ensure their survival.

programme.title: The Oceans Seven
programme.desc: André Wiersig, born in 1972, has achieved what no German has ever done before: he has swum through the world's seven most famous straits, the so-called Ocean's Seven. To prepare for it, he chose a familiar but hostile environment. In his carport, he hardened himself in a rain barrel filled with groundwater.

programme.title: Billion Dollar Fish
programme.desc: They are virtually unchanged from their ancestors, who swam in ancient rivers when the dinosaurs still ruled the planet. Their unfertilised eggs became black gold, served in only the most expensive restaurants as caviar. This ancient giant is the Beluga Sturgeon, considered by some to be the largest freshwater fish in the world. Sturgeons are now at the very edge of extinction because of the exclusive market for their eggs, but only the eggs can allow the species to live. Paradoxically, the desire for caviar may now be the only chance they have for their future existence.

programme.title: Lobsters
programme.desc: The knights of the deep are on the move almost no part of their bodies is without armor. Like medieval warriors, these fighters are well armed – not with sword and shield, but with scissors and forceps and defensive armor that is covered with spikes and hooks. And even though they are well protected and have an uncanny awareness of their surroundings, many of these proud knights will face a gloomy destiny. Many of them will end upon a plate. Gourmets all over the world are in love with these famous crustaceans: lobsters! For marine biologists lobsters are similarly fascinating: as research objects. We are on their trail in Cape Breton, an island in the northern Atlantic and part of the Canadian province Nova Scotia, where one of the largest populations of lobsters has its home.

programme.title: Vicious Beauties
programme.sub-title: The secret World of the Jelly Fish
programme.desc: Watching the graceful movement of these gelatinous animals is almost hypnotic. Although their bodies are 98% water, jellyfish are deceptively clever and dangerous. But where do these primordial creatures come from? How do they reproduce and how long do they live?

programme.title: Predators of a Different Kind
programme.sub-title: In the World of the Unknown Sharks
programme.desc: With the aid of modern technology, reveal the unknown behaviour of some unusual species of shark: lemon sharks and their white-tip reef counterparts. Our film trip begins on the Bahamas. To be more precise: in the turquoise-blue waters of the Grand Bahama Bank, in an exactly fixed location. In the spring, 70 – 80 pregnant lemon sharks arrive here. This huge shark population was first discovered just a few years ago by shark researcher, Professor Sam Gruber. Many of the females are tired and rest on the seabed. Pregnant tiger sharks swim in the midst of this group. Without any protection whatsoever, our cameramen shoot their footage, surrounded by sharks and succeed in capturing images hitherto unseen. We continue our journey to Gainesville, Florida, to meet Gordon Hubbell, the leading shark denture expert with the world's largest shark denture collection. He knows everything about the evolutionary history of the lemon sharks, in addition to those of the white-tip reef variety off Cocos Island, Costa Rica. Here, we encounter large schools of fish, unprecedented numbers of stingrays, as well as hammerhead sharks. However, it is the white-tip reek sharks that make the biggest impression. Their performance begins late at night. Marauding, they patrol in large groups through the reefs and hunt everything that moves. Scales and dead prey fish float above the reef – a welcoming change of diet for the ubiquitous barracudas.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: A fantasy episode in which Strawberry, Rainbow Sherbet, Blueberry Muffin, Coco Calypso, and Seaberry Delight imagine themselves as Mermaids, drawn into a grand adventure.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry is really touched when her girlfriends and the Berrykins volunteer to help her with the construction of her new marketplace, so when the girls suggest they take charge of designing Strawberry's dream-bedroom to go on the second story, of course Strawberry agrees. While construction is going on, the girls each show Strawberry their individual ideas for the bedroom.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With time running out before the Grand Opening celebration for the new Marketplace, Strawberry's friends get the idea to invite her favorite singer, superstar CHERRY JAM, to be the guest singer. The girls are blown away when their berryjuice cell phone gets a text message that Cherry accepts their invitation! Strawberry is touched by their surprise, but reminds them that now the town and Marketplace really have to shine!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Cherry Jam is so enjoying staying in Berry Bitty City, that she calls her managers in Big Bitty City and informs them that she is going to stay for a much needed vacation! Strawberry and the girls are thrilled that she will be with them for a little longer, and they do all they can to make their guest comfortable. But Cherry doesn't want to be treated like a guest she wants to fit in and contribute to the community.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Berry Bitty City is holding its first city-wide talent show! Hearing that it's the music students of superstar Cherry Jam, a talent scout from Big Bitty City plans to show up. Strawberry and her friends excitedly anticipate her arrival.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Raspberry is discovered by a talent scout who wants her to move to Berry Big City and design a new line of Glitter fashions! She will be provided with her own studio, staff, publicity, commitments from big department stores-everything she needs to be a big fashion designing star! All her friends are thrilled for her. Only Cherry is a bit less enthusiastic about Raspberry's stardom, which Raspberry mistakenly interprets as jealousy.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With the summer almost over, Blueberry overhears Strawberry talking about a wonderful tropical island and believes her friend is going to surprise them all with a much needed vacation! Blueberry makes the other girls promise to keep the secret until Strawberry reveals the big surprise. Of course, even though they've promised to keep the secret, they can't help but try and suss out what the island's like from every little thing Strawberry does.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: It's the last week of summer and Berry Bitty City is hopping with activity as the girls prepare for their tropical island vacation at Berry Breezy Bay Resort. But just as they're about to leave, bad news: the resort is closed for the season due to berry breezy weather. The girls are disappointed, but Orange isn't giving up. She says if they can't go to the tropical island, maybe they can bring the tropical island here!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With only a few days of summer left, the girls are about to enjoy their first vacation in their newly-created, tropical beach resort at Berry Bitty Lake, when who should descend upon them but Mavis Maraschino, the comically over-the-top "Entertainment Tonight"-style show host. Mavis has dumped her focus on fashions in favor of an even glitzier show called Lifestyles of the Berry Big Bitty Stars, and she wants her first segment to be about how pop superstar Cherry Jam spends her vacation.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: On a beautiful winter's night, Blueberry reads the Baby Berrykins a story of what happened one winter in Berry Bitty City-a winter that almost wasn't. Just as everyone is ready for winter fun and fashions, a sudden warming melts the snow and ruins their plans. Improvising with snowmen made of shaved ice and cotton puffs, Strawberry and her friends play "Capture the Snowman's Carrot Nose." The Berrykins want to join in the fun, so the girls play against them, with Strawberry refereeing.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

While master mechanic Berrykin Bruce turns Cherry's tour bus into the band's hotel-on-wheels, Strawberry and her friends pack for the big trip. programme.title: Stiix and Stones
programme.desc: The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply so the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks – and when they fail to make enough cash, the Ninja decide to steal it – but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but when the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply, the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks. Meanwhile, reluctant to give up being Samurai X, Nya struggles to embrace being a Water Ninja, and Sensei Wu gives her a riddle to figure out. Back at Stiix, when the Ninja fail to make enough cash working the docks, the Ninja decide to steal it... but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. After Moro gets away with the scroll, the Ninja are left dangling, but Ronan saves them at a price – for a piece of their share in the Tea Farm.

programme.title: Public Enemy Number One
programme.desc: The Ninja must find out as much as they can about Nadakhan before he finds the Realm Crystal to save his crew, but after the Ninja are labeled enemies by the world they used to protect, our heroes find themselves hunted by their old friend, Ronan. With the Destiny's Bounty impounded, the police hire Ronin to track down the fugitive ninja. Misako has been arrested and is confronted by Nadakhan, who reveals he has trapped Wu in the Teapot of Tyrahn. Misako accidentally reveals the location of the Realm Crystal. The ninja discover that Wu was researching djinn when he disappeared and split up to learn more about their potential new foe. Lloyd and Zane head to the Library of Domu. While there, Ronin hacks into Zane's systems and shuts him down, then captures Lloyd. Ronin uses Zane's SOS beacon to lure Kai and Nya into the desert, where they are captured. Later, Cole and Jay are defeated by Ronin as well. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has used his powers to foil the high-tech security guarding the Realm Crystal and steals it. The ninja are hauled off to Kryptarium Prison and Nadakhan is free to gather his lost crew.

programme.title: Enkrypted
programme.desc: Nadakhan vows revenge on the ninja and NINJAGO. The ninja and Soto escape from jail, only to find out the map to the island is on Nadakhan's ship. Nadakhan discovers that Nya looks just like Delara, his long-lost love.The secret, he says, is the venom of a Tiger Widow, a rare creature that lives on only one island. The venom can slow a djinn down. Soto is the only one who knows where the island is and will only tell if the ninja break him out of jail. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has decided to return to his home realm of Djinjago, only to discover it is falling apart. The ninja's destruction of the Cursed Realm is affecting the realms connected to it. Nadakhan uses the Djinn Blade to smash the Teapot, absorbing all the spirits that were trapped there into the sword. Falsely imprisoned, the Ninja are at their lowest point, but find an unlikely friend in an old enemy. Meanwhile, Nadakhan rescues his marooned crew and gains a new perspective, along with a new mysterious plan. With the ninja imprisoned, Nadakhan uses the Realm Crystal to free his old crew. The ninja encounter Captain Soto, the first captain of the Destiny's Bounty, who tells them the story of how he originally trapped Nadakhan in the Teapot.

programme.title: Misfortune Rising
programme.desc: The ninja's search for Nadakhan's ship turns up nothing. Nadakhan's crew is struggling to handle an airship which used to sail only on the oceans. Nadakhan confronts Jay and talks him into making a wish that will win him Nya. Jay wishes that he wasn't born in a junkyard and was rich. The next moment, he receives a letter saying his father has died and he has inherited his estate. Jay rushes home to find his parents in the junkyard and finds out they are fine, but they reveal that he is adopted. Jay discovers that his real father is the actor who played his favorite movie hero. In an effort to trap the ninja, the Sky Pirates start raids all over NINJAGO City. Nadakhan kidnaps Kai, who makes two wishes, both of which go wrong. His third wish is to “make it all go away.” Nadakhan's first mate, Flintlocke, accidentally destroys the Realm Crystal and Cole steals Soto's map. The Destiny's Bounty mysteriously vanishes from the police impound yard.The Ninja are on a collision course to find the map to stop Nadakhan, they first must find him. Meanwhile, Jay makes a wish to change his future, but it could alter his past indefinitely.

programme.title: The Cloud
programme.desc: A storm is brewing over Knighton. Monstrox has taken the form of a cloud, and is raising an army of lightning infused Stone Monsters. His first target is the new Lavalands Amusement Park. Harmony reigns in Knighton as the Knights pursue their civilian lives: Lance has a TV talk show Axl is the singing chef on the show Jestro is the weatherman Clay is teaching at the Knights' Academy Macy, Ava and Merlok 2.0 travel the land in the Fortrex making sure the kingdom's defenses are ready (part of a plan she and Clay have) Aaron and his hover shield is travelling the land setting extreme records. Robin is at his workshop at the Knights' Academy doing an “independent study” – he's working on some top secret project for Merlok 2.0. It all seems excellent! We even see the Knights new vehicles – which have been optimized for civilian life (except for Clay's.) But storm clouds are brewing. Well, one storm cloud is brewing: the Cloud of Monstrox! Yes, the Book of Monsters has reconstituted himself and is now a cloud who needs a man on the ground to enact his new evil plan. He follows his old buddy Jestro as he goes across the realm on the weekends apologizing for being evil. ZAP! With one bolt of his evil magic lighting, the Cloud of Monstrox turns Jestro evil again (only this time a bit, well, too evil.) The evil duo are back together – and bring stone to life for the first time in the form of Gargoyles from the town of GHOULIA. Now they must gather the Forbidden Powers so that the Cloud of Monstrox can destroy the entire kingdom! A battle breaks out in the Lava Lands, where Lance and Alice Squires are reporting from the opening of the Cuthbert Richmond funded Lava Lands Amusement Park, rebuilt from the remains of Jestro's old HQ. Jestro and the Cloud are after something in the remains and as Merlok 2.0 sends out a call for the Knights to help Lance. Can Lance (with an assist from King Halbert in his Mech) hold-off Jestro, the Cloud and their new army of stone fighters?!

programme.title: A Little Rusty
programme.desc: The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro unlocks a mysterious Forbidden Power. What kind ofhavoc will they unleash? And can Merlok 2.0 and the NEXO KNIGHTS make the new COMBO NEXO Powers work? The Knights finally make it to the Lava Lands – using their various new forms of transport, which are all strictly civilian vechicles – and they must regroup and learn to fight together again to face the new threat of Jestro, the Cloud of Monstrox, and their STONE MONSTERS (in this case, Stone Gargoyles.) But Jestro and his monsters beat back the knights and recover the STAFF OF MONSTROX – which was buried under the ceremonial chamber from Episode 210 (and is now the Lava Puker amusement park ride) – and they get away on Jestro's EVIL MOBILE, which he recovers from the HQ garage. Macy says this is exactly why she's been touring the kingdom preparing everyone for the next attack. The Knights have to get it together because now the entire kingdom is under threat…again. Robin decides he must upgrade the Knights' vehicles and make them more “fight optimized.” Ava and Merlok 2.0 must figure out how to use new NEXO Powers because regular NEXO Powers do make Stone monsters back into stone, but the Cloud simply zaps them to life again. Meanwhile, in the IRON MOUNTAINS, Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox find the first of the Forbidden Powers: RELENTLESS RUST. They find the ROGUL STATUE holding the power and zap him to life. Now…they can rust those shiny knights to pieces! Ava and Merlok are attempting to use NEXO COMBO POWERS – with hilarious results – as they try to figure out how they might work. When Jestro attacks, he's able to halt the Fortrex by instantly rusting its tracks and wheels! Robin has his hands full trying to clean all the rust from the attack of Relentless Rust. As the Knights attempt to defend against Jestro, the Cloud is zapping statues to life. He hits a statue with a bolt of lightning as Clay is touching it. Something happens…Clay feels odd stiff as if rock is mixing with his body. Finally, Ava and Merlok 2.0 download to the Knights their new thing: a COMBO NEXO COMBO Power. It works! It can smash the animated statues to dust! They use it to defeat Jestro, but he and the Cloud get away with the Forbidden Power of Relentless Rust. Victory … sort of. Clay talks to Merlok 2.0…something has happened to him. What can they do? Merlok 2.0 is very concerned.

programme.title: Thunderstox
programme.desc: Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox encounters the sculptor. He helps unleash a horde of fierce garden gnomes on Knighton. What will the NEXO KNIGHTS do against this new enemy? Will their new COMBO NEXO Powers do the trick? As Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox head off on the Evil Mobile to 'store' the Forbidden Power in a secret location, they encounter…THE SCULPTOR. His real name is ROBERTO ARNOLDI. He's a sensitive and odd artist who has been laid off by the king (the King ordered a "smashing" statue of the Queen, and the Sculptor made a statue of the Queen literally smashing monsters. He takes everything very literally.) Jestro instructs him to make a "bad" statue that he can use to attack the knights. The Sculptor sets to work. Meanwhile, the NEXO KNIGHTS are discussing the COMBO NEXO Powers, the Forbidden Powers, and what all this means. Lance, meanwhile, decides that since his talk show career is on hold, he thinks he'll install cameras in the Fortrex and do a Big Brother-like expose show on the Knights (he decides NOT to tell the others.) Merlok 2.0 and the Cloud of Monstrox (each talking to their cohorts) explain the history of the Forbidden Powers: it's a history lesson about the WIZARDS' COUNCIL, the Forbidden Powers, and how they were stopped long ago. This visual montage leads Jestro to…MOUNT THUNDERSTROX. The Cloud of Monstrox shows him the circle of ten Standing Stones where he will insert the Forbidden Powers. "What'll happen after that?” asks Jestro, curious. "Oh, I don't want to spoil the surprise," says the Cloud. They insert the first Forbidden Power, Relentless Rust, and it locks into place on its stone. They go off to battle the Knights and collect the "bad" statue the sculptor is making. But he's made a literally bad statue…it's terrible ... garden gnomes. Like an amateur art student. And…it's not even finished. ("You can't rush bad genius!") The Knights attack with their newly modified vehicles and they succeed in destroying the Evil Mobile. They then try to use a COMBO NEXO Power, but can't…it had to be perfect to work (Ava and Merlok need to work on it.) As Jestro and the Cloud retreat, Merlok again talks to Clay about turning to stone! Merlok calls in Robin…he will need him to build something to help Clay as he becomes more and more impaired.

programme.title: Weekend At Halberts
programme.desc: Party time in Knighton! The mood is down so the King decides to throw a party. In the meantime Jestro attacks the Fortrex, but he is confronted with the new NEXO Power "The Wedgie of Doom". Clay is turned to stone and everyone is gloomy. Especially King Halbert. In order to get everything in a better mood Aaron organizes a celebration. The King wants a reenactment of Clay's heroic rescue of the Queen. He is (as usual) totally unaware of Clay's situation. In order not to disappoint him further, the Knights get a remote control for Clay's Battle suit and is thus able to “perform” as Clay. Lance is happy to exercise his acting abilities and quickly gets into the role of the uptight knight of knights. Ava is working on reinstalling Merlok 2.0 into the Fortrex with Robin. She is also preparing the Fortrex for a visit from the new Knights' Academy novices. It is a fieldtrip with Principal Brickland and Sir Griffiths with the goal of teaching the kids about these new so-called High-tech battle strategies. Not really feeling it for anything modern, it quickly turns into a regular trip back memory lane for Brickland and Sir Griffiths. This out of control excursion is an excellent moment for Jestro who is looking for an opportunity to cheer up the defeated Monstrox. Unfortunately, for Jestro, Ava is able to make Merlok 2.0 functional again, and the Novices are able to fight Jestro and his monsters off using the NEXO Power: Wedgie of Doom. It is a humiliating defeat. Apparently, this is just what the doctor ordered for Monstrox. A good laugh at someone else's expense. His evil mood is back on.
